title: Segment archive v2 stage 3: close the open checks (full-size drill, Atrium test-index parity, multi-installation transport) and record the live cutover
notes: publication (temp write, file fsync, hard link, directory fsync), the
generation manifest and its base sentinel, one disposable SQLite state holding
segments, fragments, materialized records, artifact fingerprints and pending
Atrium deliveries, incremental capture keyed by
`(source, relativePath, storageKind)` over an `O_NOFOLLOW` fingerprint, a
chunked v1 migration, a verifier that builds its own state, and
`conversations:capture|migrate-segments|verify-segments|benchmark-segments`.
Measured on 25,000 synthetic artifacts, one process per pass: warm no-op 1.91s
reading 0 bytes and writing no segment; one changed artifact 1.72s reading
only its 2,096 bytes; one new conversation 1.59s; peak RSS 261 MB on the
changed pass. Against the measured v1 baselines of 226.91s and 132.36s that is
132x and 83x. **Remaining, and it is stage 3:** erasure apply/verify, object
transport between installations, handing the pending slice to
`atrium ingest --partial`, and the scheduler/hook freeze sentinel. Nothing is
pointed at `~/.local/share/rocket-agents` yet.
Since 2026-10-11 this item also carries the v1 publication cost (Codex, high:
route it here rather than add an incremental v1 hash, which would leave the
backup and the full rewrite under the lock). Baseline to beat, from the
MacBook refresh log that day: the import stage (merge + publish of 6.8 GB,
54,180 records) takes 4:12-4:34, with export 5-8 min before it. Stage 3 also
needs Atrium (`ingest --partial`) and dotfiles (scheduler and hook freeze)
changes plus the data-location and rollback plan the split design requires,
so it cannot land from this repository alone.
Decided 2026-10-11 (owner via Codex adjudication): proceed with stage 3 in
order - erasure and transport, then Atrium partial ingest, then dotfiles
freeze support, then the data location and rollback drill; cut over live data
only after the parity and recoverability checks pass. Plan and verification
commands: `docs/plans/2026-10-11-segment-archive-v2-stage-3.md`. First slice
landed `636c946` (disposable roots only): seal/activate split (activate the
old id = rollback), `applyConversationArchiveErasure` (refuses a moved plan,
rewrites survivors into a new base, selects nothing),
`verifyConversationArchiveErasure`; `pnpm run check` 121 pass.
Second slice `31d70f8` (docs `0ac0bba`): Atrium contract - erase plan
`conversationIds` + `fromGenerationId`/`toGenerationId`, `segments-inventory`
(`generationId`, `pendingDeliveries`), `export-pending`, `ack-pending`,
`export-materialized`, fixtures `fixtures/archive-contract/v2/pending-slice.jsonl`
and `erasure-plan.json`; bounded-memory planning; `pnpm run check` 126 pass.
Third slice `293a740`: export-materialized/export-pending manifests carry
`generationId` and `generationLineage` (newest first, from
`parentGenerationId` that erasures now record; ends at no recorded parent or
no held manifest); fixture `materialized-after-erasure.jsonl`; 128 pass.
`scribe erase plan|apply|verify|activate` landed 2026-10-18 (apply under the
archive write lock, plans validated, verify checks the segment set).
Segments written before 2026-10-18 (string `relativePath`) are unreadable
and must be re-migrated from the v1 archive; no live segment root exists.
`segments-receive` and `segments-seed-generation` landed 2026-10-18 (see the
plan). Remaining in scribe: freeze-sentinel refusal, recovery drill. Space at
planning time on the primary Mac: v1 archive 6.84 GB plus two same-size
backups beside it, data volume 108 GiB free (95% used); the 3x + 2 GiB rule
(~22.5 GiB) holds there, re-measure on every holder at preflight.
Decided 2026-10-11 (owner, relayed by the coordinator): segments in
`$SYNTOPICA_DATA/conversations/segments/`; state, locks and the freeze
sentinel in `~/.local/state/rocket-agents/conversations/`. Final.

2026-11-24 audit: Most of stage 3 is landed in scribe: erase plan|apply|verify|activate (9165eed), segments-receive/seed-generation (3d4f2fb), freeze sentinel refusal (a3b8a34), recovery-drill (7a33cdb), real-archive parity rehearsal 57,181/57,181 (d129b51). A live segment root now exists (the old note saying none exists is stale): ~/p/wiki/conversations/segments/ holds two generations, current-generation.json updated 2026-11-07, and ~/.local/state/rocket-agents/conversations/segment-mode is present, so cutover appears to have happened. Docs plan docs/plans/2026-10-11-segment-archive-v2-stage-3.md was last touched 2026-10-18 and still has one unchecked item (rebuild a test Atrium index from export-materialized and compare with the live index) and still lists the full-size drill and four-installation transport test as open; the plan was not updated after cutover. Not verified: Atrium/dotfiles commits, other holders. Next: confirm with owner/Atrium whether those three checks were done, tick the plan, then close; the 2,000-fragment limit task is tied to the first real seeding pass, now past.
